people.name: Edom
people.line: Descendants of Esau; enemy nation southeast of Israel

translations.web: He said, “You shall not pass through.” Edom came out against him with many people, and with a strong hand.
translations.bsb: But Edom insisted, “You may not pass through.” And they came out to confront the Israelites with a large army and a strong hand.
translations.kjv: And he said, Thou shalt not go through. And Edom came out against him with much people, and with a strong hand.
